name: Kieta Sekai to Tsuki to Shoujo -The world was prayed by the girl living a thousand years-
original_name: 消えた世界と月と少女-The world was prayed by the girl living a thousand years-
source: The protagonist Seiji comes back to his hometown, where he becomes a witness of the mystery behind the series of unsolved murder cases. One by one, every single one of Seiji's old friends, with whom he just met, disappears. The mystery under the moon's light reveals a truth little by little, thus starts the story about the disappearance of the world, the moon, and the girl...
translation: 主人公诚司回到故乡，成为一系列悬而未决的谋杀案背后谜团的见证者。与刚刚重逢的旧友一个接一个地消失。月光下的谜团逐渐揭示真相，于是，一段关于世界、月亮与少女消失的故事开始了……
